title: Embedding projected steps with bounded addresses
statement: For any word width $W$, extended program $P$, address set $K\subseteq\mathbb Z$, natural number $n$, and ordinary configurations $c,c'$, suppose the ordinary computation of length $n$ from $c$ to $c'$ under the projection of $P$ has every instruction's touched addresses in $K$. Then, for every output bit list $o$, coin count $r$, and input and coin bit lists, the extended program $P$ takes $n$ steps from the extended configuration with state $c$, output $o$, and coin count $r$ to the one with state $c'$, output $o$, and coin count $r$, with every instruction's touched addresses in $K$.
hypotheses_covered: A projected ordinary computation of length $n$ from $c$ to $c'$ whose touched addresses at every step lie in $K$
